prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset: epic premium New Year's Eve social campaign HERO ART, portrait 4:5. Create one exceptionally polished cinematic advertising image, with NO typography. It will receive editable brand/date overlays afterward.
Primary idea: a silver mirrorball reimagined as a bowling ball. A single massive hero sphere made of hundreds of tiny real mirrored square tiles, with three convincing bowling-ball finger holes worked naturally into its upper-right face. It sits on a subtly reflective warm dark wooden lane-like surface. Object is a surreal visual metaphor for a bowling venue NYE campaign, NOT a photograph of a real venue or a promised installation.
Composition: editorial luxury-event poster framing, low camera angle, hero sphere centered around x=52%, y=53%, spanning about 68% of canvas width and 48% height. Keep the top 22% and bottom 20% of the canvas richly dark and visually quiet for later headline/date overlays. The ball must have a clean, powerful silhouette. Very subtle lane perspective, no visible lane numbers, no actual room architecture, no people.
Style: premium photorealistic CGI / art-directed campaign still; tactile mirrored facets, beautiful speculars and physically plausible reflections. Cinematic depth and negative space. Make the image feel like the one arresting visual on a major NYE campaign.
Lighting/color: deep midnight indigo almost black #100b23, silver and icy-white mirror tiles, concentrated mint-teal #4EECC4 rim light, a restrained warm champagne glint. One striking narrow beam from above/behind and scattered elegant points of reflected light. Small amount of floating celebratory sparkle and two or three out-of-focus metallic confetti pieces toward the outside edges only. Luminous central object; dark quiet copy zones.
Constraints: no words, numbers, logo, watermark, borders, fake UI or countdown digits. No alcohol glasses, no fireworks, no extra balls, no gift props. Avoid cartoon globe lines, clip-art, excessive neon, busy confetti, stock-party look, plastic materials or washed-out fog. Beautiful high-detail final artwork.
notes: Cinematic symbolic mirrorball bowling-ball illustration, not a photograph of the venue or a promise of a physical installation. Logo/headline/dates added as editable HTML layers.
